title: 日経賞の後に・ここがいい

text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin wins the Nikkei Sho and makes an amazing comeback.
She realizes that she doesn't race because she has nothing else, but rather because she loves it and wants to win.
Her resolve thus renewed, Narita Taishin and I set our sights on the spring Tenno Sho.
